# MemStats

> MemStats is a free, open source (MIT) memory monitor for the macOS menu bar. It shows who is using the RAM: used memory split by user account, top apps with their helper processes grouped in, top processes, memory pressure, swap and a short history, all in one popover. Version 1.3.1, macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple Silicon and Intel.

- Memory only. It does not show CPU, GPU, disk, network, sensors or fans. Stats and iStat Menus cover those, and MemStats can run next to them.
- Made for Macs shared by several user accounts (labs, build machines, family Macs), and useful on any Mac.
- About 35 MB of memory and 0.2% CPU with the popover closed. No network requests: sampling is local and history stays in memory.
- Distributed through GitHub Releases, not the Mac App Store, because it needs the App Sandbox off to run `top` and read other users' processes. The build is not notarized yet, so the first launch needs "Open Anyway" in System Settings, Privacy and Security.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Vietnamese.
